policy excerpt: Duplicate charges are refunded in full to the original payment method within 5 business days once billing confirms the duplicate. Refunds for change of mind are only allowed within 30 days of delivery.
customer (Mar 20): I was charged twice for order 55120, $84.00 each on Mar 1. Please refund the extra charge.
automatic reply (Mar 20): Thanks for contacting us! A member of our team will reply within one business day. Visit our help center for quick answers.
internal note (Mar 21, billing): Confirmed. Two captures of $84.00 on Mar 1 for order 55120 to the same Visa ending 4417. One is a duplicate.
customer (Mar 21): Also, how do I unsubscribe from the marketing emails?
agent (Mar 21): You can unsubscribe with the link at the bottom of any marketing email, or in Account > Notifications.
customer (Mar 22): Thanks, done. Also I forgot my password but I managed to reset it myself.
